WITH
-- 1. Base set of male inpatients age 74-84
general AS (
  SELECT
    a.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime,
    a.deathtime,
    a.hospital_expire_flag,
    a.risk_score,
    p.anchor_age
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
      ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE
    p.anchor_age BETWEEN 74 AND 84
    AND p.gender = 'M'
),
-- 2. Mark AKI admissions
aki_flags AS (
  SELECT
    hadm_id,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN icd_version = 9 AND icd_code LIKE '584%' THEN 1
        WHEN icd_version = 10 AND icd_code LIKE 'N17%' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS has_aki
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd`
  GROUP BY hadm_id
),
-- 3. Mark ARDS admissions
ards_flags AS (
  SELECT
    hadm_id,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN icd_version = 9 AND icd_code = '51882' THEN 1
        WHEN icd_version = 10 AND icd_code LIKE 'J80%' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS has_ards
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd`
  GROUP BY hadm_id
),
-- 4. General cohort with flags
gen_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    g.*,
    af.has_aki,
    rf.has_ards,
    DATE_DIFF(g.dischtime, g.admittime, DAY) AS los_days,
    CASE
      WHEN g.deathtime IS NOT NULL
           AND DATE_DIFF(g.deathtime, g.admittime, DAY) <= 30 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS died_within_30d
  FROM
    general g
    LEFT JOIN aki_flags af USING(hadm_id)
    LEFT JOIN ards_flags rf USING(hadm_id)
  WHERE
    af.has_aki = 0  -- leave only general non-AKI for general reference
),
-- 5. AKI cohort
aki_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    g.*,
    rf.has_ards,
    DATE_DIFF(g.dischtime, g.admittime, DAY) AS los_days,
    CASE
      WHEN g.deathtime IS NOT NULL
           AND DATE_DIFF(g.deathtime, g.admittime, DAY) <= 30 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS died_within_30d
  FROM
    general g
    JOIN aki_flags af USING(hadm_id)
    LEFT JOIN ards_flags rf USING(hadm_id)
  WHERE
    af.has_aki = 1
),
-- 6. Compute general risk_score percentiles for ranking
gen_scores AS (
  SELECT
    risk_score,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY risk_score) AS pr
  FROM gen_cohort
),
-- 7. Attach percentile to AKI patients
aki_with_pct AS (
  SELECT
    a.*,
    gs.pr AS risk_pr
  FROM
    aki_cohort a
    LEFT JOIN gen_scores gs
      ON a.risk_score = gs.risk_score
)
SELECT
  -- AKI cohort metrics
  'AKI Cohort' AS cohort,
  -- risk_score median and IQR
  (SELECT quantiles[OFFSET(500)] FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(risk_score, 1001)) AS quantiles) AS aki_risk_median,
  (SELECT quantiles[OFFSET(750)] - quantiles[OFFSET(250)] FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(risk_score, 1001)) AS quantiles) AS aki_risk_IQR,
  -- 30-day mortality
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(died_within_30d) / COUNT(*), 1) AS aki_30d_mortality_pct,
  -- ARDS rate
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(has_ards) / COUNT(*), 1) AS aki_ards_pct,
  -- survivor LOS median
  (SELECT quantiles[OFFSET(500)]
   FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(los_days, 1001)) AS quantiles
   WHERE los_days IS NOT NULL AND died_within_30d = 0) AS aki_survivor_los_median,
  -- median risk percentile within general cohort
  (SELECT quantiles[OFFSET(500)]
   FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(risk_pr, 1001)) AS quantiles) AS aki_median_risk_percentile

UNION ALL

SELECT
  -- General cohort metrics
  'General Cohort' AS cohort,
  (SELECT quantiles[OFFSET(500)] FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(risk_score, 1001)) AS quantiles) AS gen_risk_median,
  (SELECT quantiles[OFFSET(750)] - quantiles[OFFSET(250)] FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(risk_score, 1001)) AS quantiles) AS gen_risk_IQR,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(died_within_30d) / COUNT(*), 1) AS gen_30d_mortality_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(has_ards) / COUNT(*), 1) AS gen_ards_pct,
  (SELECT quantiles[OFFSET(500)]
   FROM UNNEST(APPROX_QUANTILES(los_days, 1001)) AS quantiles
   WHERE los_days IS NOT NULL AND died_within_30d = 0) AS gen_survivor_los_median,
  NULL AS aki_median_risk_percentile  -- not applicable
FROM gen_cohort;
